opening.argument: The title presents “Touch” as an official Kehlani video, and the description’s “Download/stream now!” is an ordinary invitation to hear the release. A nighttime street scene and repeated, lyric-like audio reinforce the music-video framing. These observable elements support an entertainment release with a brand partnership, not a financial solicitation or request for personal data. Nothing in the supplied evidence describes a payment demand, a data request, or a resulting loss; the invitation is limited to downloading or streaming the song.
